_note: Regenerated post-audit3 to match data_final/SECTORAL_PNAD_EMPIRICAL.csv (broad PNAD informality). Employment shares and informality rates now match the final CSV exactly. Theta splits remain estimated from DIEESE 2024 + PNAD habitual hours; they differ from the national PNAD theta because they represent contracted hours at sector level.

vab.source: IBGE, Contas Regionais do Brasil 2021, SIDRA Table 5938 (sum of 27 UFs)

agriculture.name: Agropecuaria
agriculture.source: IBGE, PNAD Continua Trimestral 2024 Q4, broad-informality definition (as in SECTORAL_PNAD_EMPIRICAL.csv)
agriculture.notes: Agriculture highest informality under broad definition (family farming, seasonal work, self-employment without CNPJ). Formal workers cluster at 44h.

industry.name: Industria (incl. construcao)
industry.source: IBGE, PNAD Continua Trimestral 2024 Q4, broad-informality definition
industry.notes: Industry (extractive + manufacturing + utilities + construction). Broad informality includes non-CNPJ self-employed construction workers.

services.name: Servicos
services.source: IBGE, PNAD Continua Trimestral 2024 Q4, broad-informality definition
services.notes: Services encompass commerce, transport, accommodation, IT, finance, public admin, education, health, domestic work.

industry.notes: Industry: mix of 40h (continuous shifts) and 44h (standard CLT)

services.notes: Services: highest part-time share due to commerce/domestic/education
